newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda sells $3.2 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Uganda sells $3.2 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central bank of Uganda sold 3.5 billion shillings ($3.2 million) of 91-day treasury bills at the weekly auction, bank officials said on Thursday.
The bank said it sold the bills at an annualised yield of 10.978 percent, a 0.798 percent fall from last week at an average weighted price of 97.308 from 97.064.
Despite an increase in demand for T-bills, the Bank of Uganda invited tenders for two billion shillings of treasury bills for the auction on Wednesday, next week.
Bank officials said they were keeping the offer low to maintain stability in the market.
